notes.title: 📣 Attention, Survivors! The Day Of Survival Big Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Survivors!

It is with great excitement that we announce the release of the most anticipated update for The Day Of Survival! This milestone in the game's development is available today, bringing a host of innovations, significant improvements, and crucial fixes that will exponentially enhance your survival experience. Below, we highlight the main elements of this unmissable update:

New Features Implemented:


 New main menu added  ✔️
 Bug fixes  ✔️
 Savegame manager with options to save, load, or delete files  ✔️
 New pause menu  ✔️
 Optimization improvements  ✔️
 New movement animations  ✔️
 Updated missions  ✔️
 Revised achievements  ✔️
 Updated map  ✔️
 Control guide menu added  ✔️
 3D minimap implemented  ✔️
 New AI zombie models added  ✔️
 New AI human models added  ✔️
 System to detect Steam nickname and profile picture implemented  ✔️
 AI companion added✔️


[previewyoutube=ayGRcvWPWxI;full][/previewyoutube]


🔧 Improvements and Optimizations:
Performance Optimization: Implementation of performance improvements that ensure more fluid and responsive gameplay.

Refined User Interface: Complete UI redesign to provide a more intuitive and efficient user experience.

Game Balance Adjustments: Refining difficulty parameters to provide a more balanced and rewarding challenge.

We would like to express our deep gratitude for the community's continued support and feedback. Our commitment is to ensure that The Day Of Survival consolidates itself as the ultimate reference in survival games, and we look forward to hearing your impressions about these new features.


Remember, **The Day Of Survival** was developed by a single person. I ask that you have patience and understanding. I'm doing my best to offer you an amazing experience. If you find any bugs, please don't hesitate to send a support email detailing the issues you encountered. Your help is essential to improve the game!
